enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Bend knees. Remain still. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Snore lightly. Turn to back. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up and getting out of bed
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Stretch arms. Yawn. Sit up. Swing legs over edge of bed. Stand up. Pick up phone from nightstand. Press button to turn off alarm. Put phone down. Walk to door. Open door. Exit bedroom.
Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close closet. Open drawer. Take out socks. Take out underwear. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Open bag. Put laptop in bag. Put charger in bag. Put notebook in bag. Put pen in bag. Put water bottle in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag and walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Check phone for bus time. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter office building.

Enter office. Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Attend meeting. Take notes. Return to desk. Make phone calls. Type report. Print documents. Walk to printer. Pick up documents. Staple documents. File documents. Walk back to desk. Sit down.

Walk to cafe. Enter cafe. Order sandwich. Pay cashier. Receive sandwich. Walk to table. Sit down. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Throw trash in bin. Walk out of cafe. Walk back to office. Enter office.

Sit at desk. Open files. Read documents. Type report. Make phone calls. Attend meeting. Present slides. Take notes. Return to desk. Open email. Reply to emails. Organize desk. Walk to copier. Make copies. Return to desk. File documents. Write notes. Plan next day. Shut down computer. Stand up.
Walk out of office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Cook. Turn off stove. Serve on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Stand up. Place dishes in sink.
Clear table. Scrape plates. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Start dishwasher. Wipe counters. Wash pots. Dry pots. Put away pots. Sweep floor. Empty trash.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Adjust lamp. Read more. Turn page. Close book. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get glass of water. Walk back to living room. Sit down. Open book again.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer or phone to wind down
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Open browser. Browse websites. Watch video. Type message. Send message. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open app. Scroll through feed. Like post. Put down phone. Close laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting ready for bed and reading
enriched_activities.desc: Change into pajamas. Fold clothes. Put clothes in hamper. Pick up book. Get into bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read more. Turn page. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes.
Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to other side. Stretch legs. Snore lightly. Turn to back. Remain still.
